title: Database Lab (ChatGPT) and the database graph
summary: The Database Lab (packages/oorexx_oodialog_database_lab_v0.1, code: ChatGPT; architecture: Tom Dyer) adds a database panel to the designer (site/database-lab.js, database-lab.css, tools/database.rex, db.* keys in OodUi). It was merged into branch oodialog-designer as dfb0c83 after its A1-A5 fixes. Part B, a graph of a database that draws each mapped object around its tables, is ChatGPT's open work (Falcon REQ-00003619, REQ-00003625, REQ-00003637). Its input is ObjectStore~graphLines from the mapped-objects package.
invariants: The graph reads graphLines; it does not parse annotations itself (sphere mapped-objects, article mapped-objects.graph-lines, is the contract).
The Lab makes tables and columns; the mapped-object map only checks against them.
